description: did:vh resolution vectors: basic. Call didvh-resolve with input; compare didResolutionMetadata.error and problemDetails.vhLog.code, or the document, metadata and sorted warning codes.

cases.name: genesis
cases.description: A one-entry did:vh log, passed directly.

cases.name: latest
cases.description: Three entries; the latest DID document is returned.

cases.name: version-number
cases.description: versionNumber selects an earlier version; updated still reflects the log.

cases.name: version-time
cases.description: versionTime selects the version active at that time.

cases.name: version-number-not-found
cases.description: A versionNumber past the end of the log.

cases.name: version-id-not-found
cases.description: A versionId not in the log.

cases.name: version-time-before-creation
cases.description: A versionTime before the first entry.

cases.name: unknown-option-ignored
cases.description: Options this resolver does not know (such as accept) are ignored.

cases.name: min-copies-one
cases.description: minCopies 1 is met by the log passed directly.

cases.name: min-copies-two
cases.description: minCopies 2 cannot be met without watchers.

cases.name: trailing-newline-optional
cases.description: A log without its final newline.
